title: Traveling Salesmen
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael introduces a computer named Harvey with inappropriate humor to Jim and Pam, while organizing a sales competition called the 'Amazing Race' with paired employees. Kevin confronts Angela about missing tax forms, and Andy reveals his plan to undermine Dwight by chipping away at Michael's support. Dwight faces punishment from Michael for attempting to get his job and later dramatically resigns. Meanwhile, Pam wins an art contest and shares her success, and tensions arise as Dwight and Angela discuss the consequences of their relationship becoming public. The episode also explores Jim's feelings about Pam and the dynamics of the sales team as they work to secure deals emphasizing customer service.
